# String escape

Escape and unescape string literals for JSON, Go, C#, SQL and shell.

Category: Encoders · ID: `escape` · Search terms: unescape, quote, literal, string, backslash

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui escape [encode|decode] [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `encode`, `decode` | `encode` | Mode. |
| `--lang` | `json`, `go`, `csharp`, `sql`, `shell` | `json` | Language. Encoding gives the inside of the literal (shell: a whole quoted word); decoding accepts it with or without quotes |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/escape`), so they are what the tool prints.

### mixed-csharp

Input:

```text
He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It's $HOME `pwd`
```

Output:

```text
He said \"hi\" \\ bye\n\tTab, café, 🍕 and an ESC: \u001b end\nIt's $HOME `pwd`\n
```

### mixed-go

Input:

```text
He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It's $HOME `pwd`
```

Output:

```text
He said \"hi\" \\ bye\n\tTab, café, 🍕 and an ESC: \x1b end\nIt's $HOME `pwd`\n
```

### mixed-json

Input:

```text
He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It's $HOME `pwd`
```

Output:

```text
He said \"hi\" \\ bye\n\tTab, café, 🍕 and an ESC: \u001b end\nIt's $HOME `pwd`\n
```

### mixed-shell

Input:

```text
He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It's $HOME `pwd`
```

Output:

```text
'He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It'\''s $HOME `pwd`
'
```

### mixed-sql

Input:

```text
He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It's $HOME `pwd`
```

Output:

```text
He said "hi" \ bye
	Tab, café, 🍕 and an ESC:  end
It''s $HOME `pwd`
```
